extensions.question: Does the predicate fail a unit whose artifact exists, parses and carries the sentinel but was never registered in ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json? PASS requires the manifest check read the manifest FROM DISK, not from the writer's in-memory claim.
extensions.answer: YES: platform/lib/completion_predicate.py@v1 fails condition 11 when the artifact exists, parses, and carries its sentinel but command-center/ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json on disk has no matching row. Registering that row flips C11 to SATISFIED. A check that trusts receipt.manifest_registration.registered=true (or in-memory unit_manifest.derive()) wrongly SATISFIES the unregistered tree and is rejected.
